---

### **Factual Evidence by Category**

* **All-NBA First Team:**
  * **LeBron James:** 13 selections (2005–06, 2007–08, 2008–09, 2009–10, 2010–11, 2011–12, 2012–13, 2013–14, 2014–15, 2015–16, 2016–17, 2017–18, 2019–20) [lebron_accolades_160], [lebron_accolades_240].
  * **Michael Jordan:** 10 selections (1986–87, 1987–88, 1988–89, 1989–90, 1990–91, 1991–92, 1992–93, 1995–96, 1996–97, 1997–98) [jordan_accolades_160].

* **All-NBA Second Team:**
  * **LeBron James:** 4 selections (2004–05, 2006–07, 2020–21, 2024–25) [lebron_accolades_160], [lebron_accolades_240].
  * **Michael Jordan:** 1 selection (1984–85) [jordan_accolades_160], [jordan_accolades_240].

* **All-NBA Third Team:**
  * **LeBron James:** 4 selections (2018–19, 2021–22, 2022–23, 2023–24) [lebron_accolades_240].
  * **Michael Jordan:** Not provided in the supplied text [jordan_accolades_160], [jordan_accolades_240].

---

### **Trade-offs and Context**

* **Total Volume and Longevity:** LeBron James accumulated a higher total number of All-NBA selections (21 total listed: 13 First Team, 4 Second Team, and 4 Third Team selections) [lebron_accolades_160], [lebron_accolades_240], reflecting sustained high-level play over an extended span.
* **Peak Concentration:** Michael Jordan’s selections in the provided record are concentrated heavily at the absolute top tier, earning 10 First Team nods out of 11 recorded All-NBA selections [jordan_accolades_160], [jordan_accolades_240].

---

### **GOAT Debate Perspective (Subjective vs. Factual)**

While the factual evidence clearly gives LeBron James the advantage in total First Team selections (13 to 10) and total overall All-NBA selections [jordan_accolades_160], [lebron_accolades_160], how these metrics factor into "Greatest of All Time" (GOAT) judgments remains subjective. Analysts favoring LeBron emphasize sustained elite longevity across multiple decades, whereas those favoring Jordan place greater weight on dominant peak concentration alongside other accolades such as championships and Finals MVPs [jordan_accolades_80].
